test_implicit_conversion: test the pybind11 thread module by running m.test across three concurrent threads with GIL
test_implicit_conversion_no_gil: test the pybind11 thread module by running m.test_no_gil across three concurrent threads without GIL
run_Thread_class: run a callable function 10 times in a background thread using the Thread helper class
review_Thread_run: review the Thread class run method that calls a function 10 times and captures exceptions
review_Thread_join: review the Thread class join method that re-raises any exception caught during the run
